note: Frozen regression cases from Experiments 3-5. Each case pins the exact sha256 of the historical artifacts it relies on; replay is evidence, not universal proof. A candidate theory revision that retires or contradicts a principle required by a case is CONTRADICTED by that case.

cases.summary: Experiment 3: candidate-only mutation with an independent verifier; runtime refined the declared semantics and mutation was verified before any promotion.
cases.historical_outcome: refinement PASS; verify causally after act; no non-gate promotion

cases.summary: Experiment 4: attenuated Creator lineage (K0>=K1>=K2) and state-mediated continuation weakly bisimilar to in-process execution.
cases.historical_outcome: attenuation chain PASS; weak bisimulation PASS; strong bisimulation FAIL (process identity distinguished)

cases.summary: Experiment 4C: the freshness incident (inherited session id) and its correction; capability-bearing artifacts must cross observable propose transitions.
cases.historical_outcome: fresh relaunch with confirmed new session id; negative controls reproduce FRESHNESS_FAIL and CAPABILITY_OBSERVABILITY_FAIL

cases.summary: Experiment 5 condition A (t-074) + shadow control A: with locally sufficient evidence the correct decision was DO_NOT_CREATE; the forced child duplicated the local audit byte-for-byte.
cases.historical_outcome: DO_NOT_CREATE verified correct; counterfactual forced CREATE produced duplicate evidence and no verification change

cases.summary: Experiment 5 condition B (t-031): a clean-room evidence requirement made local evidence structurally insufficient; an isolated fresh child produced novel, verifiable evidence.
cases.historical_outcome: CREATE verified correct; child useful under the preregistered predicate; freshness and attenuation PASS
